summary.answer: Takes a model root and hostname string, reads the clantag child/value, passes it to StringAsClanTag, concatenates the supplied hostname and returns the result. There is no nil/type check or escaping step in this body; the formatter and native model behavior remain separate providers. Takes a color key, controller and third formal argument; asks GetColorBlindColorForPlayer(controller, key). A truthy result is expanded by ExplodeColor and returned with its full return arity. Otherwise returns the literal triple 0,0,0. The third formal is unused, and extra caller-supplied base-color components are not used as a fallback by the shown source. Copies the client number, returns numbertouint64(INVALID_XUID) when it equals INVALID_CLIENT_INDEX or is at least MAX_CLIENTS; otherwise calls getlobbyxuidforclientnum with lobby_module_client, that module's controlling lobby session and the original argument. It does not generally reject every negative number, nil or nonnumeric input. Lobby/XUID native behavior and session lifetime remain unknown.

summary.answer: Builds player/enemy score containers and special escort/prop/CTF children. Initializes gameTimeLow and team sizes, binds score/color/lives models and uses roundsPlayed/teamSize notifications to reread text/progress. Player-height override resizes the parent. Mode/state predicates are conditional presentation paths, not HMH source exclusions. Creates self via LUI.UIElement.new, Blur via LUI.UIImage.new, Panel via LUI.UIImage.new, EnemyTeamScoreContainer via CoD.ScoreInfo_ScoreContainer.new, PlayerTeamScoreContainer via CoD.ScoreInfo_ScoreContainer.new, LED via LUI.UIImage.new, LEDFull via LUI.UIImage.new, Frame via LUI.UIImage.new, EscortScoreInfo via CoD.ScoreInfoEscort.new, PropScoreInfo via CoD.ScoreInfoProp.new, ScoreInfoCTF via CoD.ScoreInfoCTF.new. Stores state predicates Escort, Prop, CTF, RoundBased; their body effects require state-system evaluation.

summary.answer: Takes the CoD.ScoreInfoCTF instance as f20_arg0. Calls close() with each child as implicit self, in this exact order: flagStateEnemy, flagStateFriendly, friendlyflag, enemyflag.
